title: Algorithm: Linear Scan Maximum Finder
subtitle: Finding Extremes Without Built-ins
description: Find highest value in an array across 2 interactive stages!
starter_code:
scores = [45, 88, 72, 95, 60]
# Stage 1: Scan and find maximum

challenges.title: Stage 1: Find Maximum Score
challenges.description: Initialize <hlt>max_val = scores[0]</hlt>. Loop through <hlt>scores</hlt>, if <hlt>s > max_val:</hlt> update <hlt>max_val = s</hlt>. Print <hlt>max_val</hlt>.
challenges.starter_code:
scores = [45, 88, 72, 95, 60]
max_val = scores[0]
# Stage 1: Linear scan max
for s in scores:
    if s > max_val:
        max_val = s
print(max_val)

challenges.title: Stage 2: Find Minimum Score
challenges.description: Initialize <hlt>min_val = scores[0]</hlt>. Loop to find the minimum value. Print <hlt>min_val</hlt>.
challenges.starter_code:
scores = [45, 88, 72, 95, 60]
min_val = scores[0]
# Stage 2: Linear scan min
for s in scores:
    if s < min_val:
        min_val = s
print(min_val)
